# anthropic_service_account (Data Source)

Looks up one service account by id or name. Requires `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_service_account" "by_name" {
  name = "inference-worker"
}

data "anthropic_service_account" "by_id" {
  id = "svac_01ExampleServiceAcct000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Service account id (`svac_...`). Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Slug name; only live (unarchived) service accounts are matched.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Description; null when empty.
- `organization_role` (String) Organization role (`developer` or `admin`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
